channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jabari Smith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jabari Smith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steven Adams on Jabari Smith, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Steven Adams on mentoring Jabari Smith Jr. and Alperen Sengun:

“I just go the old school just bullying tactic. Just bully them. That's just fun. Especially the Turkish people, mate. Got to bully those guys. But no, it's been good, honestly, mentoring them and just seeing the growth. It is still exciting and just again, competing at that level and seeing the growth throughout the year, not just as an individual, but as a team.”

Steven Adams on Jabari Smith, Alperen Sengun, Aug 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tari Eason on Jabari Smith
item.description:
Rockets forwardTari Eason on Jabari Smith Jr.:

“I don't know if people have labeled him fully a dog, but he's a dog. You know, he's a pit bull off the leash,just ate some chocolate, you know what I'm saying?”

Tari Eason on Jabari Smith, Nov 3, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Alperen Sengun on Jabari Smith, Steven Adams
item.description:
Alperen Şengün on Steven Adams:

“Steven was really effective in the Zone. He talks a lot. He knows where to stand and directs me and Jabari a lot”

Alperen Sengun on Jabari Smith, Steven Adams, Aug 17, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: Jeff Green on Jabari Smith
item.description:
“It’s tough with Jabari (Smith Jr.) going down. He’s a vital piece of what we do. It’s going to take some time for us to get used to the rotations, who’s out on the floor, because of what he brought to the team. So collectively, we need to do our part in making each other look good, but we have to do it as a committee. We have to go out there, share the ball and play more together. And that’s going to take some time, but with the personnel and coaches we have, we’ll figure out something.”

Jeff Green on Jabari Smith, Jan 4, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on Jabari Smith
item.description:
“I just saw it on my phone, yeah. I mean, that's a lot of weight coming down on a big's legs. Obviously, we hope he's all right. You never want to see any injuries in any type of game, Fox told reporters. “But, I mean, as great as well as he's been playing this year, you know, you definitely don't want to see that. And I mean, obviously, Jabari Smith makes a hard foul and he's jumping, And he was jumping straight up, and unfortunate things can happen,”

De'Aaron Fox on Jabari Smith, Mar 11, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tari Eason on Jabari Smith
item.description:
David Hardisty:Tari Eason:

“Me and Jabari, we hang out damn near every day. We're always with each other, always talking basketball. It just bleeds into everything. You see how we communicate. We're brothers.”

Tari Eason on Jabari Smith, Jul 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Jabari Smith
item.description:
Stephen Silas on Jabari Smith Jr.:

“He is young and trying to find his way. Jabari has grit and toughness and tries defensively. Andhe’s not given much at all … I don’t run any plays for Jabari.”

Stephen Silas on Jabari Smith, Feb 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Jabari Smith Jr on Jabari Smith
item.description:
“It’s been tough, honestly, because I feel like I’ve been winning all the way up to this point,”

Jabari Smith Jr on Jabari Smith, Feb 15, 2023. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Jabari Smith
item.description:
Said Rockets coach Stephen Silas:

“He is young and trying to find his way. Jabari has grit and toughness and tries defensively. And he’s not given much at all … I don’t run any plays for Jabari Smith.”

Stephen Silas on Jabari Smith, Feb 15, 2023. Source: Andscape.
